correctness.rationale: For odd m, root-one block is k[Q8], other inversion/Frobenius blocks are full 2x2 matrices over unramified local length-four chain rings. In the Q8 block x^2=0 forces all reduced coefficients zero and x lies in central square-zero ideal (1+z)k[Q8], giving H_q=1+(q-1)z+(q^3-q)z^2+q^3(q-1)z^4. Matrix valuation strata give P_Q coefficients; orthogonal blocks add regular-image ranks, so product rank polynomial, total q^4 product(3Q^8-2Q^6), and maximum 4m follow. Independently enumerated all 65,536 matrices over F2[t]/(t^4), testing X^2=0 and F2-linear image rank by fresh elimination: lengths 0..4 counts 1,9,78,168,384 (total 640). This finite check is not the proof of arbitrary q,m; the crossed-product norm splitting and local valuation arguments supply that generality.
